head: b677654

root_cause.summary: verifyTaskGoal had no branch for a declared-destination navigation goal. The canonical task 'open the store catalog' matched none of the six task-shape branches (no search/login/shopping/product/bag/details/scroll/account-number/canvas token, no maxPrice/size/color constraint) and reached the catch-all IN_PROGRESS under every browser state.
root_cause.proved_structural: verifyTaskGoal returned the identical IN_PROGRESS for a correct LISTING@0.99 gen-9 observation and for wrong-page ARTICLE, low-confidence 0.1 and stale-generation observations — the failure was evidence-independent.
root_cause.not_a_fail_open_path: It was a permanent fail-closed hole: DestinationVerifier MATCH could complete the subgoal but nothing connected that to task success, so the task could never terminate successfully.

production_changes.change: Added branch 7 (declared-destination navigation goals) plus helper verifyDeclaredDestinationGoal and isOutstandingTaskRequirement.
production_changes.authority_preserved: Adds no URL matching, page-role matching, confidence floor, freshness test, destination normalization or UNKNOWN/MISMATCH semantics. Delegates entirely: verifyTaskGoal -> GoalProgressTracker.verifySubgoalCondition -> verifyDestination. Re-runs that chain against the CURRENT observation, so a stale graph alone cannot certify. Returns null only when no destination subgoal exists; every other path is IN_PROGRESS.

production_changes.change: Added a target-namespace disambiguation paragraph rendered when the page carries affordances, stating affordance/entity ids are descriptive metadata and not valid targets.
production_changes.justification: Authorised by the task's SECONDARY ISSUES clause: the real G7 run proved it still required. Run 3 reproduced the defect live — Groq proposed target 'affordance-scroll-1', backend correctly refused with HTTP 422 unknown_target. The fix is generic prompt text naming no URL, path, affordance name or fixture selector.
production_changes.authority_preserved: Grounding unchanged. routes/agent.py still refuses any target absent from current detections; extension M5 re-validates independently.

provider_capacity.correction: Step 10.5 recorded ~2400 prompt tokens and an 8000 TPM limit. Measured: PROMPT_CHARS=3216 (~807 tokens); the binding limit is requests-per-minute, and Groq publishes an explicit Retry-After (12s observed).
provider_capacity.paced_probe: 5 calls at 13s spacing -> 4 OK, 1 transient 429 with Retry-After: 4s. 6 back-to-back calls -> 3 OK then 429.
provider_capacity.conclusion: The loop needs a 4th provider call to submit the search form; the free tier's RPM ceiling plus the dead fallback makes that call fail consistently in 2/2 real runs.

remaining_blocker: Provider capacity. Fixing it requires teaching the loop to honour the provider's published Retry-After for rate limits, which means a third production file (extension/src/agent/agentLoop.ts or backendAgentProvider.ts) — outside the authorised scope for this task.
